text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and would love to support your team as a General VA. With 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I bring a strong mix of organization, attention to detail, and reliable execution.

I’ve built customer segments from Shopify order exports by recency, frequency, and spend in Google Sheets and Looker Studio, which helped identify a top segment representing 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and supported a 19% increase in email revenue. I also built a daily on-time delivery dashboard by depot, driver, and customer in Power BI and SQL, which contributed to late deliveries falling by 9% over the following quarter.

I’m confident I can help with email management, scheduling, data entry, research, document formatting, and other admin tasks with consistency and care.
